progression.narrative: The performance opens on G4 and dwells most on G in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (1:16.4) introduces Gs, centred on G. Phrase 3 (2:03.4) introduces Cs, centred on Bb. The line peaks at Ak4 (416.1 Hz) at 2:50.9. It closes on Eb4, not the tonic (Eb4 → Eb4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Dk4 → Eb4).
